title: Embeddings described as local-only (MiniLM)
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:310 'embedded with `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` running locally'; :358 'No native external vector DB integration (lorebook uses local embeddings only).' Also contradicts the skill's own lorebooks.md:279 (pick a connection with an Embedding Model or Local Model), agents.md:353 (Memory Recall needs an embedding source) and SKILL.md:266 (active connection's embedding model, falling back to local).
reality: Memory Recall and lorebook semantic search use the **Semantic Search (Embeddings)** source set on a connection (embedding model, optional Embedding Endpoint URL, **Embedding Connection** = Same as this connection / Local Model (sidecar) / another connection). The built-in local model is only the fallback when none is set (engine docs/agents/memory.md:34-48; docs/lorebooks/semantic-search.md:17-35). Changelog: embedding connections accept a base URL or full /embeddings endpoint for NanoGPT/OpenRouter (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:1502, #5252, v2.4.4); NanoGPT lorebook vectorization (#5688, :1286); Random Model chats stay on the configured embedding source instead of falling back to the local embedder (#4864, :1778); batching for local embedding providers (#6837 :263, #6708 :372).
fix: architecture.md Special Features 'Semantic memory' bullet: say messages are embedded with the chat connection's configured embedding source (Semantic Search (Embeddings) on a connection; hosted model, Local Model sidecar, or another connection), falling back to the built-in local MiniLM only when none is set; re-check the chunk/top-K numbers in window B. What's NOT Built-In bullet: replace '(lorebook uses local embeddings only)' with 'remote embedding models are supported via a connection's Embedding Model, but there is no external vector-DB (Pinecone/Weaviate) integration' to match SKILL.md:266.

title: v2.5.0 Robustness/storage env vars missing from env list
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:324 'Env vars added in 2.4.x–2.5.0 — MARINARA_MAX_RESIDENT_CHATS / MARINARA_EAGER_STORAGE ...; LOREBOOK_STABLE_GROUP_WINNERS / PROVIDER_RETRY_TRANSIENT_ERRORS ... Full list: docs/CONFIGURATION.md' — no STORAGE_*/SHUTDOWN_* or LOREBOOK_COMPACT_STORED_SCANS
reality: v2.5.0 adds opt-in, off-by-default Robustness settings: `STORAGE_SKIP_UNCHANGED_WRITES`, `STORAGE_YIELDING_SERIALIZE` (large chat saves no longer pause other requests), `STORAGE_CACHE_WINDOWS_BOOT_ID` (~1.5–2 s faster Windows start), `SHUTDOWN_WINDOWS_CONSOLE_SIGNALS`, `SHUTDOWN_FORCE_EXIT_ON_REPEAT`, `SHUTDOWN_EARLY_FLUSH`, `SHUTDOWN_RUNTIME_STOP_BUDGET_MS` (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:518; engine docs/CONFIGURATION.md:369-380), and `LOREBOOK_COMPACT_STORED_SCANS` + `scripts/compact-lorebook-scans.mjs` to shrink chats with big lorebooks (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:532; CONFIGURATION.md:363). The last is covered in lorebooks.md:248 but not here beside its sibling LOREBOOK_STABLE_GROUP_WINNERS.
fix: architecture.md:324: append 'Opt-in Robustness switches (all off by default, see CONFIGURATION.md → Robustness): STORAGE_SKIP_UNCHANGED_WRITES, STORAGE_YIELDING_SERIALIZE, STORAGE_CACHE_WINDOWS_BOOT_ID (Windows), SHUTDOWN_WINDOWS_CONSOLE_SIGNALS / SHUTDOWN_FORCE_EXIT_ON_REPEAT / SHUTDOWN_EARLY_FLUSH / SHUTDOWN_RUNTIME_STOP_BUDGET_MS; LOREBOOK_COMPACT_STORED_SCANS (+ scripts/compact-lorebook-scans.mjs, see lorebooks.md)'. One line; a Data Storage cross-ref to STORAGE_YIELDING_SERIALIZE helps long-chat users.

title: API surface misses 2.4.3–2.5.0 host routes
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:266-290 (API Surface list) — no admin diagnostics, Experience-state/generation, package-asset or /api/health notes
reality: v2.5.0: privileged `GET /api/admin/runtime-diagnostics` reports storage residency and per-package runtime liveness; every request log line carries `requestId`, returned as `x-request-id` (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:518, :530; packages/server/src/routes/admin.routes.ts). `/api/health` answers without a password but shows local model names/GPU only to this machine, a trusted network or a signed-in browser (:28). v2.4.3 host routes for package authors: `GET`/`PUT /api/game/:chatId/experience-state` (#5102, :1538; game.routes.ts), `POST /api/game/:chatId/experience-generation` (#5135, :1534), package assets at `/api/capability-packages/<id>/assets/<path>` (1.10, #5091, :1544), `POST /api/sprites/pixelize` (#5096, :1541).
fix: architecture.md API Surface: add one bullet for diagnostics (`/api/admin/runtime-diagnostics`, `x-request-id`, `/api/health` visibility rule) and one for Game-surface Experience host routes (`/api/game/:chatId/experience-state`, `/experience-generation`) + `/api/capability-packages/<id>/assets/*`, pointing to docs/development/optional-agent-packages.md.
